topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I was just out for a stroll, the kind of day where the clouds hang low and the air feels thick. Around the old oak in the backyard, where the grass is patchy and the earth is soft, I stumbled upon something half-buried. A metal box, rusted by time and sealed with a purpose. I crouched down, my hands brushing away dirt and leaves. Inside, the contents were a mix of forgotten mementos—letters, a small toy, photographs of people I didn’t recognize. Each item felt like a whisper from a past I couldn’t recall, a life lived and lost to the remoteness of memory. The silence around me seemed to echo the questions I couldn’t voice, the answers lost to the years that had slipped away.
